name: Daily Corporation and Other Entity Filing Data
attribution: New York State Department of State
description: This data contains Corporations and other Entities filing information that were processed in the previous thirty days.  Each line contains the Department of State ID number, Film ID, Date Filed, Effective Date, Entity Name, the law under which the filing was made and other pertinent filing information.
